description: Source code for a web component 'todo-app' implementing a to-do list application with DOM manipulation, event handling, and routing.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Custom HTML element class managing a to-do list application with internal state, event handling, and routing.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new to-do item to internal data and updates the list display.

methods.name: toggleItem
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a specific to-do item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a to-do item from internal data and updates the display.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates the title of a specific to-do item.

methods.name: toggleItems
methods.description: Toggles all to-do items' completion status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates UI attributes based on current data state.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to UI components.

methods.name: removeListeners
methods.description: Removes event listeners from UI components.

methods.name: routeChange
methods.description: Handles route changes and updates the view accordingly.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when element is added to DOM; initializes state and routing.

methods.name: disconnectedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when element is removed from DOM; cleans up event listeners.
